hypothesis: A quiet visual anchor may serve as a new experimental reference when the original preset return was not visually confirmed. This does not claim that the new anchor equals the original preset.

preconditions.old_preset: preserved and neither recalled nor removed by this trial

one_controlled_trial.recovery: Create a new preset at the current visual anchor. The native watchdog stops the finite pulse. One GoToPreset is allowed. A compact no-raster anchor is persisted if return cannot be visually confirmed.

forbidden: recall of the earlier preserved preset
deletion of the earlier preserved preset

gate.pass: quiet visual baseline, observed displacement at least 2 pixels, quiet return with overlap at least 0.85 and displacement at most 15 pixels
gate.failure: preserve the new preset and descriptor; pause before another movement
